questions.text: There are 3 red socks, 4 green socks and 3 blue socks.You choose 2 socks. The probability that they are of the same colour is
questions.solution:
Same-colour pairs: [latex]\binom32+\binom42+\binom32=3+6+3=12[/latex] out of [latex]\binom{10}{2}=45[/latex].

[latex]P=\frac{12}{45}=\frac4{15}[/latex]

Answer: [latex]\frac4{15}[/latex]

questions.text: A test has twenty questions worth 100 marks in total. There are two types of questions. Multiple choice questions are worth 3 marks each and essay questions are worth 11 marks each. How many multiple choice questions does the exam have?
questions.solution:
Let m MCQs and e essays: m + e = 20 and 3m + 11e = 100.
[latex]3m+11(20-m)=100\Rightarrow8m=120\Rightarrow m=15[/latex]

Answer: 15

questions.text: There are five buildings called V, W, X, Y and Z in a row (not necessarily in that order). V is to the West of W. Z is to the East of X and the West of V. W is to the West of Y. Which is the building in the middle?
questions.solution:
From west to east: X is west of Z, Z west of V, V west of W, W west of Y [latex]\rightarrow[/latex] X, Z, V, W, Y.

The middle building is V.

Answer: V

questions.text: Saturn is ___________ to be seen on a clear night with the naked eye.
questions.solution:
"Enough" goes after an adjective: bright enough to be seen.

Answer: bright enough

questions.text: Choose the option with words that are not synonyms.
questions.solution:
Aversion/dislike, luminous/radiant and plunder/loot are synonyms. Yielding (giving way) and resistant are opposites.

Answer: yielding, resistant
